caseName: Dunitz v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: DUNITZ v. CITY OF LOS ANGELES
attorneys: John W. Holmes for appellants., Roger Arnebergh and Bourke Jones for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition’ for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
